english.note: Use this when explicitly saying that something suits a particular person, purpose, or task.

exampleSentences.english: This job is suitable for you.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 sik1 hap6 nei5

english.note: Use 適合 when something is well suited to a particular purpose, role, or environment rather than merely proper in general.

exampleSentences.english: These shoes fit the bill for hiking.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 deoi3 haai4 sik1 hap6 haang4 saan1
